missing_claims.claim: Individual v2-labelled V(D)J enrichment primer-pool members for v3
missing_claims.evidence: CG000734 Rev A lines 651–725 and 3334–3417 specify eight v2 Mix 1/2 PN identifiers; original CG000331 Rev E Appendix lines 6848–6996 prints the forward and all outer/inner reverse sequences under those same PNs. The shared research note transcribes the members. This establishes published identities for the named kits, not transcript-coordinate mapping or lot-specific composition.

conclusion: Two independent source readings agree: the v3 guide names the same v2-labelled enrichment Mix part numbers for which the predecessor vendor guide publishes primer members. The prior unavailable-member claim is resolved. The v3 guide independently specifies N16/N12 gel-bead and V(D)J dual-index library architecture; sequence-to-transcript coordinates remain outside the published guide.
